message.content: {"note_claim": "The extended 2024–2025 ISS stay of Suni Williams and Butch Wilmore resulted from Boeing Starliner thruster failures and helium leaks.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "What initially appeared to be a minor issue evolved, over the next two and a half months, into NASA’s biggest human spaceflight safety crisis since the shuttle Columbia accident more than two decades ago.", "reason": "The article details how Starliner's thruster problems and helium leaks led NASA to return the capsule uncrewed and keep Wilmore and Williams on the ISS for months, with no mention of toilet issues."}

parsed.note_claim: The extended 2024–2025 ISS stay of Suni Williams and Butch Wilmore resulted from Boeing Starliner thruster failures and helium leaks.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: What initially appeared to be a minor issue evolved, over the next two and a half months, into NASA’s biggest human spaceflight safety crisis since the shuttle Columbia accident more than two decades ago.
parsed.reason: The article details how Starliner's thruster problems and helium leaks led NASA to return the capsule uncrewed and keep Wilmore and Williams on the ISS for months, with no mention of toilet issues.
